battle.name: 契丹滅後晉之戰
battle.theater: 河北定州白團衛村一線
battle.brief: 後晉天福八年十一月（西曆943年12月），契丹主耶律德光率蕃漢大軍南下，於河北定州白團衛村擊潰後晉北行營都統杜威的步騎，盡取晉軍器甲，兵鋒直抵滑州。其後契丹再入寇，946年杜威以河北諸鎮降敵，洛陽、汴州失守，後晉遂亡。卡面秦連弩是城頭連射之具，合於此役城守與野戰交錯之局。

kit.name: 秦連弩
kit.history: 弩機把拉力存起來，一踩一發。守城的一方靠它把攻城的人壓在牆外。

countries: 交戰的兩方，是北方的契丹與中國北方的後晉。契丹此時尚未改國號為遼，名號仍是契丹國，首都初在臨潢府，後遷上京會同府，南京則設於燕京（今北京一帶），既是契丹南征的前進基地，也是軍械輜重的集結地。契丹本部是游牧部眾組成的騎兵主體，耶律氏皇族居中，另有從燕雲漢地歸附的蕃漢兵與漢人將領組成的漢軍，專司守城、操弩砲、駕砲車，是南征中攻城與守城技術的主要承擔者。後晉則是936年石敬瑭藉契丹兵入洛陽、廢後唐而建立的政權，疆域大體沿用中原舊界，北界止於燕雲十六州；這十六州正是石敬瑭在936至937年間割予契丹之地，因此這場戰爭一開始就帶著盟約與反噬的性質。後晉的軍隊由禁軍以及河北、山西各鎮節度使所部組成，裝備沿用唐末以來的步騎配甲，弩、砲、砲車並重；後晉一方的編年偏簡，兵制細節多有闕漏。必須說明的是，本役的記載主要靠《資治通鑑》《舊五代史》《新五代史》與《遼史》互相對勘，雙方對同一場戰役的說法並不總是一致，數字尤其互有出入。
countriesEn: The two belligerents were the Khitan in the north and the Later Jin in northern China. The Khitan state had not yet been renamed Liao; it was still the Khitan country, with its capital first at Linhuang and later moved to Shangjing Huizhou, while its southern capital stood at Yanjing, in the area of modern Beijing, which was both the forward base for the southern campaigns and the muster point for arms, ordnance and baggage. The Khitan core was a mounted force drawn from pastoral clans, with the Yelü imperial house at its head, supplemented by Fan-Han troops and Han Chinese officers gathered in the Yan-Yun region, who handled fortification work, operated heavy crossbows and stone-throwers, and carried most of the technical burden of siege and defence in the invasion. The Later Jin was the polity founded in 936 by Shi Jingtang, who entered Luoyang with Khitan troops and overthrew the Later Tang; its territory broadly followed the old Central Plains boundaries, with its northern edge ending at the sixteen Yan-Yun prefectures, the very districts that Shi Jingtang ceded to the Khitan between 936 and 937, so that this war carried from the outset the character of a broken covenant and its reversal. The Later Jin army was made up of the imperial guard and the troops of the military governors of Hebei and Shanxi, equipping in the step-peasant fashion inherited from the late Tang, with crossbows, artillery and stone-throwers all in use; the Later Jin annalists wrote sparsely, so much of its military system is lost. It must be said that the record of this campaign can only be reconstructed by collating the Comprehensive Mirror in Aid of Governance, the Old and New History of the Five Dynasties and the History of Liao, and the two sides do not always tell the same engagement the same way, with the figures especially in disagreement.
people: 本役的主帥是契丹主耶律德光，即後來改國號為大遼的太宗。他在耶律阿保機死後以皇太弟身分掌契丹兵權，是943至947年間北方最有力的軍事統帥；白團衛村之戰、946年的最後一輪南征與入汴州改國號，都是他親自統軍。漢人君臣的主角是後晉高祖石敬瑭與出帝石重貴父子。石敬瑭九三六年藉契丹兵入洛陽建後晉，九三七年割燕雲十六州與契丹結父子之盟；九四二年正月他病逝於洛陽，臨終與契丹的關係已因河北調兵、拒絕交出重鎮而破裂。其子石重貴即位時年紀尚輕，不肯再向契丹稱臣，自稱「朕」而不稱「孫」，不繳歲幣，兩國使節往還屢生衝突。《資治通鑑》載，朝臣王章因力主稱臣納幣而被石重貴下令處死，朝中由此分為主戰、主和兩派；其後奉命出使契丹的樞密使李崧被扣而遭殺害，兩國往來就此斷絕。北方實際統帥是杜威，後晉北行營都統兼樞密使：九四三年十二月白團衛村一敗後，他收拾殘兵再整，九四四年引兵救洛陽，九四六年率河北諸鎮之眾降於契丹，兵鋒遂直指洛陽與汴州，後晉的崩潰與他的投降在同一個冬天完成。另一位握重兵而不降者是河東節度使劉知遠，據守太原，日後成為後漢高祖；契丹南征能夠數度深入河北而始終未能拿下河東，與此大有關係。
peopleEn: The commander of this campaign was the Khitan ruler Yelü Deguang, the Taizong who would rename the state Great Liao. After the death of Yelü Abaoji he held Khitan military power as imperial younger brother, and was the strongest commander in the north between 943 and 947; the battle at Baituantwei, the last southern campaign of 946 and the entry into Bianzhou with the change of dynastic name were all led by him in person. The central Han figures were the Later Jin founder Shi Jingtang and his son Shi Chonggui, the Later Jin emperor. Shi Jingtang entered Luoyang with Khitan troops in 936 and founded the Later Jin, and in 937 ceded the sixteen Yan-Yun prefectures and concluded a father-and-son covenant with the Khitan; in the first month of 942 he died of illness at Luoyang, by which time his relations with the Khitan had already broken down over the deployment of troops in Hebei and his refusal to hand over key garrisons. His son Shi Chonggui was still young when he took the throne, refused to call himself a subject of the Khitan any more, used the word 'We' instead of 'grandson', withheld the customary tribute, and the exchange of envoys between the two states broke down repeatedly. The Comprehensive Mirror records that the minister Wang Zhang was executed on Shi Chonggui's order for pressing the court to acknowledge Khitan suzerainty and pay tribute, and the court thereafter split into a war party and a peace party; later the chief councillor Li Song, sent as envoy to the Khitan, was detained and killed, and intercourse between the two states came to an end. The real commander in the north was Du Wei, commander of the northern field army and chief councillor of the Later Jin: after the defeat at Baituantwei in December 943 he gathered the broken troops and reorganised them, marched to relieve Luoyang in 944, and in 946 surrendered to the Khitan together with the troops of the Hebei circuits, opening the road straight to Luoyang and Bianzhou, so that the collapse of the Later Jin and his defection were completed within the same winter. Another man who held heavy troops and refused to surrender was Liu Zhiyuan, military governor of Hedong and garrison holder of Taiyuan, who later became the founding emperor of the Later Han; the fact that the Khitan could push repeatedly into Hebei yet never took Hedong has much to do with him.
kits: 卡面兵器是秦連弩，又稱連弩、步甲弩，是弩的一種改進形制：把上弦蓄力的動作交給弩機內的槓桿與鉤弦，人只需在匣中補箭、踩動機件，即可用連續的動作把箭一支出膛。它射程不及床弩與大弩，但射速遠勝單弩，便於在城頭、塹壕邊與缺口處對密集隊形反覆射擊，也便於伏兵在短時間內傾瀉箭雨，是守城一方壓制攻城梯隊的典型利器。就本役的時間與地域而言，十世紀上半葉的河北、河南與燕雲邊城，正是弩砲技術最成熟的區域：城頭固定安裝的大弩（後世稱弩砲）負責遠距攔截，守軍另備拋石機（砲車）打擊攻城塔與城頭密集人馬，攻城一方則用撞竿、雲梯、穴地、蒙罽與火攻配合。這套守城器械體系是漢地工匠的產物，契丹南征時大量徵用漢人工匠與降附的漢軍來操作，漢軍同時也是契丹軍中最擅長城攻的一支。必須老實說明：白團衛村是野戰而非攻城，《資治通鑑》與《遼史》都沒有記錄該役使用連弩；本卡兵器與本役的直接關係，在於它是這場戰爭所反覆爭奪的城防器械譜系中的近身連射之具，與之同列的還有步弩、臂弩、拋石機與砲車。此外，兩軍的機動全靠馬匹：契丹騎兵講究馬群與備用馬的攜帶，後晉的邊軍則以輜重車隊沿黃河與河北御河運糧，弩手多配置在步兵方陣的兩翼與後衛，用以在行軍與退卻時遮護。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is the Qin repeating crossbow, also called the liannu or the foot repeating crossbow, an improved form of the crossbow in which the drawing and storing of the power is left to levers and hooks inside the lock: the archer need only feed an arrow into the magazine and press the mechanism, and the shots can be loosed in rapid succession by a repeating motion. Its range is shorter than that of the bed crossbow and the great crossbow, but its rate of fire far exceeds that of the single-shot crossbow, which makes it easy to shoot repeatedly at massed formations from the wall top, from the ditch edge or through a breach, and easy for an ambush to pour a shower of arrows within a short time; it is the characteristic weapon with which the defenders press attacking columns against the wall. As to the date and place of this campaign, the Hebei, Henan and Yan-Yun border towns of the early tenth century were precisely where crossbow artillery had reached its maturity: heavy crossbows fixed on the wall tops (later called crossbow bombards) handled long-range interception, the garrison also had stone-throwers on carts to strike the siege towers and the crowded figures on the wall, and the besiegers worked with battering poles, ladders, mining under the foundations, hides and fire. This siege apparatus was the product of Han craftsmen, and the Khitan recruited Han artisans and surrendered Han troops in large numbers to work it during the southern campaigns; the Han army was also the part of the Khitan force best suited to taking towns. It must be said plainly: Baituantwei was a field battle and not a siege, and neither the Comprehensive Mirror nor the History of Liao records the use of a repeating crossbow there; the relation of this card's weapon to this campaign lies in its being the close-range rapid-fire piece of the fortification repertoire that the fighting repeatedly contested, sitting alongside the hand crossbow, the arming bow, the stone-thrower and the trebuchet. In addition, the manoeuvre of both armies rested on horses: the Khitan cavalry carried herds and remounts, while the Later Jin frontier troops moved grain by baggage train along the Yellow River and the imperial canal of Hebei, and crossbowmen were posted on the flanks and the rear of the infantry line, to cover the march and the withdrawal.
tactics: 先說這場戰爭的整體樣態：它不是一次性會戰，而是三年裡反覆的南進、掠奪、北還與追擊、固守的拉鋸，因此每一季的戰術都圍繞兩件事——怎樣在平原上擊潰對方，以及怎樣在沒有馬匹草料的地方撐過冬天。943年12月白團衛村一役的過程，《資治通鑑》記載得相當具體：契丹先以精騎前出接觸，晉軍見敵寡而進；契丹使者隨後持假軍令入晉軍營中，聲稱杜威已被擊敗，晉軍大恐，自相奔潰；契丹乘勝追至河際，盡取晉軍器甲與馬匹。這是一套典型的騎兵心理戰加追擊：不必正面硬撞，只要摧毀一支軍隊的指揮與信心，它就會自己解體。晉軍在野戰中的常規部署是中軍為禁軍與北行營主力，兩翼為各鎮兵，騎兵在外側展開以遮蔽步兵，弩手列在陣後與兩翼，負責在推進與退卻時壓制追兵；一旦退路被切斷或糧道被斷，散兵極易自潰。進攻方面，契丹每到一季便分兵：一路趨河北諸城與軍鎮，一路直取洛陽、鄴都一線的糧道與漕運節點，以斷晉軍的河北糧餉。守城方則以弩砲在城頭與城門樓分層射擊，用砲車打擊靠近的攻城塔與填壕人馬，連弩這類便於連射的器械最適合填補密集射擊的缺口。撤退與脫身同樣是戰術的一部分：契丹深入河北後往往因塞外苦寒、草料不足而無法久滯，943年冬打到滑州、逼近洛陽之後便北還，把大批繳獲的器甲、馬匹與糧秣帶回塞外；後晉則靠各鎮分守、堅城不出的辦法拖到下一季。史料也記載，契丹軍中常備漢人通譯與熟悉河北道路的嚮導，抄糧道、襲城鎮是其慣用手法。
tacticsEn: First, the overall shape of this war: it was not a single decisive battle but a repeated cycle of three years of marching south, plundering and withdrawing north against pursuit and stubborn defence, so the tactics of every season turned on two questions - how to shatter an enemy on the open plain, and how to survive the winter where there is no fodder for the horses. The course of the action at Baituantwei in December 943 is set out in some detail in the Comprehensive Mirror: the Khitan first put forward picked cavalry to make contact, and the Jin troops advanced when they saw that the enemy was few; then a Khitan messenger entered the Jin camp carrying a forged order and announced that Du Wei had already been beaten, and the Jin army, seized by panic, broke up and ran for itself; the Khitan pursued the rout to the river and took the Jin armour and horses. This is a classic cavalry psych stratagem plus pursuit: there is no need to smash head-on, only to destroy the command and the confidence of an army, and it will come apart on its own. The usual Later Jin deployment in the field placed the imperial guard and the main body of the northern field army in the centre, the troops of the circuits on the flanks, the cavalry deployed outside to cover the infantry, and the crossbowmen in the rear and on the flanks to hold off pursuers during the advance and the withdrawal; once the line of retreat was cut or the supply road lost, troops in flight dissolved very easily. On the offensive, the Khitan split their forces each season: one body moved towards the towns and garrisons of Hebei, another struck the supply lines and the canal nodes between Luoyang and Ye, in order to cut the grain the Jin depended on in Hebei. The defenders answered with layered crossbow fire from the wall tops and the gate towers, used stone-throwers on carts against the siege towers that came close and against the men filling the ditches, and a rapid-fire piece such as the repeating crossbow was exactly what filled the gaps in that dense fire. Withdrawal and escape were equally part of the art: the Khitan, once deep in Hebei, could not stay long because of the bitter cold beyond the passes and the shortage of fodder, and after striking as far as Huazhou and pressing up to Luoyang in the winter of 943 they withdrew north again, carrying off the great mass of captured armour, horses and grain; the Later Jin, for its part, held on until the next season by splitting the defence among the circuits and refusing to leave the walls. The sources also record that the Khitan army habitually carried Han interpreters and guides who knew the roads of Hebei, and raiding the supply lines and striking towns out of the blue were their usual methods.
data: 這場戰爭的可核數字並不多，謹慎處理的原則是只寫有典據的大約數。幾項基礎事實是明確的：燕雲十六州在936至937年間割予契丹，契丹因此在北方取得了幽州（後稱南京燕京）、雲州（後稱西京大同）等城與一段邊防線；後晉自936年建國至946年末覆亡，國祚約十年；石敬瑭九四二年正月卒於洛陽，石重貴在位約五年。943年12月白團衛村一役，《資治通鑑》記晉軍以北行營都統杜威為統帥，統步騎數萬，而契丹以精騎為前鋒；同書記契丹所獲晉軍器甲以數十萬計、馬匹以萬計，並記晉軍死傷慘重、屍骸填塞道路。數萬、數十萬、以萬計這類量詞本身就是不精確的表述，不同史家鈔本常有出入，故本文只取其量級，不作確數。白團衛村的地望，一般據《資治通鑑》上下文繫於河北定州（宋定州軍節度使治所，今河北定州市一帶）附近，另有考訂置於涿州東南，說法並存，本文取定州說，故經緯度以定州為準。行程與距離方面，自燕京南下至洛陽跨越燕山與河北平原，達數千里；洛陽與定州之間亦隔著數百里平原與數條河川，中間有滑州、鄴都等節點，後晉的糧道即沿黃河轉河北御河輸送。時間上，943年十一月（後晉天福八年）契丹發兵，十二月白團衛村既敗，隨後直抵滑州、逼近洛陽；944、945、946年各有新的一輪南侵；946年十一月杜威降，契丹軍入洛陽，石重貴出降；947年初契丹主入汴州，改國號大遼，後晉正式滅亡。傷亡數字除白團衛村一役的概數外，諸史皆不載，本文不作任何推算。
dataEn: Few verifiable figures exist for this war, and the prudent rule is to give only approximate numbers with a documentary basis. Several basic facts are firm: the sixteen Yan-Yun prefectures were ceded to the Khitan between 936 and 937, giving the Khitan such cities as Youzhou, later the southern capital Yanjing, and Yunzhou, later the western capital Datong, together with a stretch of frontier; the Later Jin lasted about ten years, from its foundation in 936 to its collapse at the end of 946; Shi Jingtang died at Luoyang in the first month of 942, and Shi Chonggui reigned for roughly five years. For the battle at Baituantwei in December 943, the Comprehensive Mirror records that the Jin troops were commanded by Du Wei as commander of the northern field army and numbered some tens of thousands of foot and horse, while the Khitan put picked cavalry in front; the same book records that the Khitan took Jin armour and weapons to the tune of several hundred thousand pieces and horses to the tune of several tens of thousands, and that the Jin losses were heavy, the dead filling the roads. Terms such as 'several tens of thousands' and 'to the tune of' are themselves imprecise and differ between copies of the historians, so only the order of magnitude is used here and no exact figure is asserted. The site of Baituantwei is generally tied by the context of the Comprehensive Mirror to the neighbourhood of Dingzhou in Hebei, the seat of the Dingzhou Army Circuit, in the area of modern Dingzhou city; other readings place it to the south-east of Zhuozhou, and the two views coexist, so the Dingzhou reading is followed here and the coordinates are given for Dingzhou. As to distance, the march from Yanjing down to Luoyang crosses the Yanshan range and the Hebei plain, reaching several thousand li; between Luoyang and Dingzhou lie several hundred li of plain and a number of rivers, with nodes such as Huazhou and Ye along the way, and the Later Jin grain route ran from the Yellow River over into the imperial canal of Hebei. As to chronology: the Khitan took the field in the eleventh month of 943, in the Later Jin era of Tianfu; the battle of Baituantwei was lost in the twelfth month, after which the Khitan drove straight to Huazhou and pressed up to Luoyang; new invasions followed in 944, 945 and 946; in the eleventh month of 946 Du Wei defected, the Khitan army entered Luoyang and Shi Chonggui surrendered; in the early months of 947 the Khitan ruler entered Bianzhou, changed the state name to Great Liao, and the Later Jin was formally extinguished. Apart from the rough figures for Baituantwei, the histories give no casualty numbers at all, and none are estimated here.
cause: 打起來的原因至少有五層，而且層層相扣。第一層是盟約的破裂：936年石敬瑭借助契丹兵入洛陽建國，事後割燕雲十六州，與耶律德光結父子之盟；對契丹而言，這是一份用中原土地換取中原政權的長約，可以安枕；對中原而言，這是一份把北方屏障送給外族的城下之盟。九四二年石敬瑭死後，其子石重貴不肯再向契丹稱臣，自稱「朕」而不稱「孫」，不繳歲幣，兩國使節往還屢生衝突，王章因主和而被殺、李崧出使被殺，雙方的默契就此終結。第二層是契丹自身的擴張壓力：耶律阿保機建國之後，契丹在草原上的勢力已臻強盛，畜牧、騎射與馬群資源不足以支撐其所需，中原的財貨、鐵器、絲帛與良馬是他們最需要的東西，掠奪中原則是這類邊境強權最慣用的財政與軍需來源。第三層是後晉內部的脆弱：石重貴即位後主戰主和分裂，河北各鎮久於苦戰、怨望叢生，北行營兵疲於奔命而糧餉不繼。第四層是地理：契丹以幽州為基地南下，河北平原一望無垠、無險可守；後晉雖有黃河與太行作屏障，但幽雲已失，屏障只剩名稱。第五層是歷史的節奏：從後唐到後晉，中原在二十年間經歷了幾次易姓改代，每一次換朝代都削弱了北方的軍力與號召力，契丹南下時所要對付的，正是一個沒有強主、沒有名將、也沒有可用之兵的王朝。
causeEn: There were at least five layers of reason behind the fighting, and they interlock. The first is the breaking of the covenant: in 936 Shi Jingtang entered Luoyang with Khitan troops and founded the Later Jin, and afterwards ceded the sixteen Yan-Yun prefectures and concluded a father-and-son covenant with Yelü Deguang. To the Khitan this was a long-term bargain trading Central Plain land for a Central Plain government, a thing one could sleep soundly on; to the Central Plain it was a treaty under the city walls, handing the northern shield to a foreign people. When Shi Jingtang died in 942, his son Shi Chonggui refused to go on calling himself a subject of the Khitan, used the word 'We' instead of 'grandson', and withheld the tribute, and the exchange of envoys broke down repeatedly until Wang Zhang was killed for pressing for peace and Li Song was killed on his mission, and the understanding between the two sides was finished. The second layer is the Khitan's own pressure to expand: after Yelü Abaoji built the state, Khitan power on the steppe had become strong, and pastoral herds, mounted archery and horse stocks were not enough to sustain what the court required; the wealth, iron, silk and good horses of the Central Plain were what the Khitan most needed, and raiding the Central Plain is the habitual fiscal and supply method of frontier powers in such a position. The third layer is the weakness inside the Later Jin: after Shi Chonggui took the throne the court split between war and peace, the Hebei circuits were worn down by long campaigns and full of grievance, and the northern field army was exhausted from constant marching with no reliable grain. The fourth layer is geography: the Khitan marched south from their base at Youzhou, and the Hebei plain is flat and offers nothing to hold a battle; the Yellow River and the Taihang were supposed to be the Jin shield, but with Yan and Yun already lost the shield was a name and nothing more. The fifth layer is the rhythm of history: between the Later Tang and the Later Jin the Central Plain changed dynastic hands several times inside twenty years, and each change weakened the military strength and the authority of the north, so what the Khitan faced when they came south was a realm with no strong ruler, no famous commander and no usable army.
impact: 這一場戰爭結束的不只是後晉，而是中原北部整整一代人的格局。首先是政權更替：後晉在946年底至947年初崩潰，太原的劉知遠所建立的後漢接管了中原，隨後是後周、宋，北方與中原的王朝像走馬燈一樣換了幾輪，而每一輪都為契丹贏得更多緩衝。其次是燕雲十六州的身分改變：在936至937年間它們是割地，在943至947年間它們成了契丹的南面屏障與進攻跳板，947年遼主入汴州後，幽雲防線從此成為遼的基本國策的一部分，此後宋、遼百餘年拉鋸，雙方都無法再把這片地要回去，中原王朝只能靠雲州、太原與河北諸城與之相持。第三是軍隊與人事的流動：白團衛村之後，河北邊軍大量潰散，降卒被契丹收編，後漢與後周初期的軍隊裡有相當一部分是這樣的北方潰兵與降人；杜威降後，契丹得以用漢人將領與漢軍來經營漢地，這正是遼初南北面官體制的雛形，契丹主以少量兵力控制廣土、以漢人治漢地的做法由此定型。第四是武器與防禦的經驗：本役把守城器械的重要性推到極處，弩砲、砲車、連弩這類器械在河北與河南諸城反覆發揮作用，契丹軍在此過程中大量吸收漢地攻城技術，後來遼軍攻略幽雲諸城所用的攻城裝備，源頭大半在這幾年的河北攻防。第五是對中原國策的長遠影響：從此北方不再是中原王朝內部的藩鎮混戰，而是一個與中原平起平坐、甚至壓過一頭的外來政權，宋初對北方只能採取守禦與榷場並用的長期策略。
impactEn: What this war ended was not merely the Later Jin but the whole pattern of a generation in the north of the Central Plain. First, a change of government: the Later Jin collapsed at the end of 946 and in the early months of 947, the Later Han founded at Taiyuan by Liu Zhiyuan took over the Central Plain, and after it came the Later Zhou and the Song, so that the dynasties of the north and the Central Plain changed hands in quick succession, each turnover granting the Khitan one more buffer. Second, a change in the status of the sixteen Yan-Yun prefectures: between 936 and 937 they had been a cession, between 943 and 947 they became the Khitan's southern shield and their springboard for attack, and after the Liao ruler entered Bianzhou in 947 the You-Yun line became part of the basic Liao state policy, so that in the more than a hundred years of Song-Lao contention neither side could take the territory back, and the Central Plain dynasties could only hold them off from Yunzhou, Taiyuan and the fortified towns of Hebei. Third, a movement of troops and men: after Baituantwei the frontier armies of Hebei broke up in large numbers and their surrendered men were taken into Khitan service, and a good share of the early Later Han and Later Zhou armies consisted of such northern refugees and defectors; after Du Wei's surrender the Khitan were able to govern Han lands with Han officers and Han troops, which is the embryo of the Liao system of northern and southern administrations, and the pattern of a Khitan ruler holding a wide territory with a small force while Han men administered Han districts was thereby fixed. Fourth, lessons in weapons and defence: the campaign pushed the importance of fortification equipment to the limit, with heavy crossbows, stone-throwers on carts and repeating crossbows doing repeated service in the towns of Hebei and Henan, and the Khitan army absorbed Han siege technique on a large scale in the process, so that the siege equipment the Liao later used against the towns of You and Yun had its source mostly in these years of fighting in Hebei. Fifth, a long-term effect on Central Plain strategy: the north was now no longer a jumble of rival military governors inside the Central Plain dynasties but a foreign power on a par with the Central Plain or even pressing it, and the Song at the outset could only pursue a long-term policy of holding the line and running border markets side by side.
result: 結局可以分三段看。第一段是943年12月白團衛村：契丹大勝，後晉北行營的步騎主力崩潰，器甲與馬匹盡為契丹所取，但契丹自己也沒能佔領河北，冬寒、草料與長距離補給迫使他們帶著繳獲北還，把洛陽的門戶白白讓了半年。這一仗之後，雙方都知道對方一時吃不掉自己，於是戰爭變成每年一季的入寇與反入寇，後晉延續了近三年，靠的是各鎮分守、堅城不出與幾次勉強的野戰。第二段是944至946年的消耗：契丹再入寇，晉軍屢敗於河北，趙州、定州一線與河北漕運線不時受衝擊；朝中主戰派得勢的結果，是杜威的北行營實力越耗越空，也越來越疏離朝廷。第三段是946年十一月：杜威以河北諸鎮之眾降於契丹，契丹軍長驅而入洛陽，石重貴奉表出降，同行宗室與將佐在押解途中被殺（《資治通鑑》所述），後晉至此名存實亡；947年初，契丹主耶律德光進入汴州，改國號為大遼，後晉正式滅亡。契丹拿到了中原的門戶，卻沒能守住中原本身：入汴州後其主力因糧秣、疫病與歸路拉長而很快北撤，河北、山西仍由劉知遠的後漢接管，中原進入後漢、後周、宋的連續更替，而契丹把燕雲十六州與河北以北之地變成自己的南疆。這場從943年打到947年的戰爭，於是成了中原王朝南遷、北疆固化的起點。
resultEn: The outcome can be read in three stages. The first is December 943 and Baituantwei: a great Khitan victory, the main body of the Later Jin's northern field army broken, its armour and horses taken by the Khitan; but the Khitan could not hold Hebei either, and the winter cold, the fodder shortage and the long supply line forced them to withdraw north with their booty, leaving the gateway to Luoyang open for half a year for nothing. After that battle both sides knew they could not swallow the other for the time being, so the war settled into a season of invasion and counter-invasion each year, and the Later Jin lasted nearly three more years on the strength of the circuits holding separate sectors, refusing to leave their walls, and on a few desperate field actions. The second stage is the grinding of 944 to 946: the Khitan came again and again, the Jin were beaten repeatedly in Hebei, and the line from Zhaozhou to Dingzhou and the Hebei grain route were struck at repeatedly; the result of the war party gaining the upper hand at court was that Du Wei's northern field army grew steadily weaker and more estranged from the throne. The third stage is November 946: Du Wei surrendered with the troops of the Hebei circuits, the Khitan army drove into Luoyang, and Shi Chonggui surrendered by written submission, his accompanying kinsmen and officers being killed on the road while under escort, as the Comprehensive Mirror records; the Later Jin was by then a name and nothing more. In the early months of 947 the Khitan ruler Yelü Deguang entered Bianzhou, changed the state name to Great Liao, and the Later Jin was formally extinguished. The Khitan gained the gateway of the Central Plain but could not hold the Central Plain itself: after entering Bianzhou their main force withdrew north quickly, short of grain and worn by disease on a lengthening line of march, and Hebei and Shanxi remained in the hands of Liu Zhiyuan's Later Han, while the Central Plain passed through the successive Later Han, Later Zhou and Song, and the Khitan turned the sixteen Yan-Yun prefectures and the lands north of Hebei into their own southern frontier. This war of 943 to 947 was thus the starting point both of the southward drift of the Central Plain dynasties and of the hardening of the northern frontier.
